passage:
Ross and his mum went to the small stall.
Ross got golf clubs and golf balls. 
The golf balls are small.

The man from the stall said Ross can hit the balls in the hall. 
Ross taps the ball with the club. 
The ball rolls up the hall and hits the tall wall.

“Look at me!” Ross calls to Mum from the hall. 
He did not want to stop but Mum said he had to go. 
It was fun to hit all the golf balls!
